theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 26 群

items.colloc: lead to success 導致成功 | lead to a result 導致某結果
items.distinct: result in 導致結果 | contribute to 有助於
ex: Poor communication often leads to serious misunderstandings.
溝通不良往往會導致嚴重的誤解。
This new policy will lead to higher operational costs.
這項新政策將導致更高的營運成本。
The narrow hallway leads to the main conference room.
這條狹窄的走廊通往主會議室。

items.pos: phr. 為…做準備；導致（事件發生前）
items.colloc: lead up to the event 為事件做準備 | lead up to the deadline 臨近截止日期
items.distinct: prepare for 準備 | pave the way for 為…鋪路
ex: The team is working hard to lead up to the launch.
團隊正努力為產品發布做準備。
Several small incidents led up to the major conflict.
幾次小衝突引發了後來的重大爭執。
We analyzed the factors that led up to the merger.
我們分析了導致這次合併的各項因素。

items.colloc: lean over to look 靠過去看 | rest on the railing 倚靠欄杆
items.distinct: lean against the wall 靠在牆上 | hang over the railing 懸在欄杆上
ex: The supervisor leaned over the railing to observe the site.
主管靠在欄杆上觀察現場狀況。
Please do not lean over the railing for safety reasons.
基於安全考量，請勿倚靠欄杆。
A man is leaning over the railing while talking on his phone.
一名男子正靠在欄杆上講電話。

items.colloc: limited edition watch 限量版手錶 | release a limited edition 發行限量版
items.distinct: mass production 大量生產 | exclusive collection 獨家系列
ex: This limited edition fountain pen is highly sought after.
這款限量版鋼筆非常搶手。
We decided to purchase the limited edition software package.
我們決定購買該限量版軟體套裝。
Only five hundred units of this limited edition were manufactured.
這種限量版產品僅生產了五百個。

items.colloc: load a truck with boxes 用箱子裝載貨車 | finish loading a truck 完成裝車
items.distinct: unload a truck 卸貨 | pack a truck 整理貨車
ex: The workers are busy loading a truck at the warehouse.
工人們正忙著在倉庫裝載貨車。
He helped the driver load a truck with new merchandise.
他協助司機將新商品裝上貨車。
It takes two hours to fully load a truck.
裝滿一輛貨車需要兩個小時。

items.colloc: adjust the load size 調整裝載量 | optimize the load size 優化負載大小
items.distinct: cargo capacity 貨運容量 | shipment volume 運輸量
ex: Please verify the load size before the departure.
出發前請確認裝載量。
The machine can handle a larger load size than expected.
這台機器能處理比預期更大的負載量。
We need to reduce the load size for international shipping.
我們需要減少國際運輸的裝載量。

items.colloc: lock up the office 鎖好辦公室 | lock up the files 將檔案鎖好
items.distinct: close down 停業 | shut down 關閉
ex: Remember to lock up the warehouse before you leave today.
今天離開前記得把倉庫鎖好。
She is the last one to lock up the building.
她是最後一個離開並鎖好建築物的人。
Did you lock up the confidential documents in the safe?
你把機密文件鎖進保險箱了嗎？

items.zh: 看起來不一樣；顯得不同
items.colloc: look different from before 看起來與之前不同 | make it look different 使其看起來不同
items.distinct: appear different 看起來有異 | seem different 似乎不同
ex: The new website layout makes the pages look different.
新的網站排版讓頁面看起來很不一樣。
After the renovation, the office looks different.
裝修後，辦公室看起來顯得不同了。
These two products look different but function the same way.
這兩項產品外觀不同，但功能一樣。

items.colloc: add to a mailing list 加入通訊錄 | update the mailing list 更新郵寄名單
items.distinct: contact list 聯絡人清單 | customer database 客戶資料庫
ex: Please add my email address to your mailing list.
請將我的電子郵件地址加入你們的通訊錄。
We use a mailing list to send newsletters to clients.
我們利用郵寄名單發送電子報給客戶。
The marketing team updated the mailing list this morning.
行銷團隊今天早上更新了郵寄名單。

items.colloc: make a delivery on time 準時送貨 | schedule to make a delivery 安排送貨
items.distinct: deliver goods 運送貨物 | receive a delivery 收到貨物
ex: The courier will make a delivery later this afternoon.
快遞員將於今天下午稍晚進行配送。
We make a delivery to the downtown area every Tuesday.
我們每週二會往市中心送貨。
They were unable to make a delivery due to heavy snow.
由於大雪，他們無法進行配送。

items.colloc: make a mistake in calculations 計算錯誤 | avoid making a mistake 避免犯錯
items.distinct: commit an error 產生錯誤 | err 犯過失
ex: It is easy to make a mistake when typing quickly.
快速打字時很容易犯錯。
Please check your report again to avoid making a mistake.
請再次檢查你的報告，以避免犯錯。
The accountant admitted he made a mistake in the summary.
會計師承認他在總結報告中犯了一個錯誤。

items.pos: phr. 採取行動；搬家；啟程
items.colloc: make a move to start 開始行動 | make a move before others 在他人之前採取行動
items.distinct: take action 採取行動 | set off 出發
ex: It is time for us to make a move on this proposal.
我們現在是時候對這項提案採取行動了。
The company will make a move into the international market.
公司將採取行動進入國際市場。
We should make a move now to reach the venue on time.
我們現在就該出發，才能準時抵達會場。

items.colloc: make a note of the date 記下日期 | make a note of instructions 記下說明
items.distinct: take down 寫下 | jot down 草草記下
ex: Please make a note of the revised meeting time.
請記下修改後的會議時間。
I will make a note of your suggestions for future reference.
我會記下你的建議以供日後參考。
Make a note of any questions you have during the presentation.
請在簡報期間記下你有任何疑問之處。

items.colloc: make a recording of the lecture 錄下演講 | allow to make a recording 允許錄音
items.distinct: record a video 錄影 | take a transcript 做逐字稿
ex: The technician will make a recording of the board meeting.
技術人員將會為董事會會議進行錄音。
We decided to make a recording for those who missed the session.
我們決定為錯過會議的人製作一份錄音檔。
Are you allowed to make a recording during the interview?
面試期間允許進行錄音嗎？

items.colloc: make a selection from the menu 從菜單中選擇 | assist you to make a selection 協助你挑選
items.distinct: choose 選擇 | select 挑選
ex: Take your time to make a selection from our product catalog.
請慢慢從我們的產品目錄中挑選。
Customers can make a selection online before visiting the store.
顧客可以在前往門市前先在網路上進行選擇。
It is difficult to make a selection among these great candidates.
要在這些優秀候選人中做出選擇很困難。

items.colloc: make a stop at the station 在車站停靠 | make a stop for lunch 中途停下來吃午餐
items.distinct: stop over 中途過夜 | pause 暫停
ex: The tour bus will make a stop at the local museum.
觀光巴士將會在當地博物館中途停留。
We need to make a stop at the post office first.
我們需要先在郵局停一下。
The train will make a stop in every major city.
火車將會在每個大城市停靠。

items.colloc: make a transfer to another account 轉帳到另一個帳戶 | make a transfer at the airport 在機場轉機
items.distinct: wire money 匯款 | switch 轉換
ex: You can make a transfer using our mobile banking application.
您可以使用我們的行動銀行應用程式進行轉帳。
Passengers need to make a transfer to reach their final destination.
乘客需要轉乘才能抵達最終目的地。
I will make a transfer to cover the invoice amount.
我會進行轉帳以支付帳單金額。

items.colloc: make an exception for someone 為某人破例 | refuse to make an exception 拒絕破例
items.distinct: give an exemption 豁免 | waive a rule 放棄規則
ex: The manager agreed to make an exception for this urgent case.
經理同意為這起緊急案件破例。
We cannot make an exception to our company policy.
我們不能對公司政策破例。
She decided to make an exception because of his excellent record.
因為他表現優異，她決定破例一次。

items.colloc: make an impression on someone 給某人留下印象 | make a good impression 留下好印象
items.distinct: leave a mark 留下痕跡 | influence someone 影響某人
ex: The candidate made a positive impression during the interview.
這位候選人在面試時留下了良好的印象。
Dressing professionally helps you make an impression in meetings.
穿著專業有助於在會議中留下好印象。
He really wants to make an impression on the new director.
他非常希望能給新任總監留下深刻印象。

items.pos: phr. 沒有例外；一律相同
items.colloc: make no exception for anyone 對任何人都不例外 | allow for making no exception 規定沒有例外
items.distinct: without exception 無一例外 | apply to all 適用於所有人
ex: All employees must attend the training, making no exception.
所有員工都必須參加培訓，沒有例外。
The security rules apply to everyone and we make no exception.
安全規則適用於每個人，我們不會有任何例外。
We make no exception to the deadline for submitting reports.
我們對於提交報告的截止日期絕不破例。
